name: Summon Principality
description: (Tag:summon)Temporarily summon a middle-ranked Angel or Holy Spirit from the Heavenly Realm, such as Noble Light Spirits, Principalities, Valkyries, 6 Winged Angels, etc., limited to Elite familiar power or less. Bound to your will, it needs your constant energy to stay and use magic; slain angels restore in the Heavenly Realm and can be resummoned, and more energy lets them exert more power. You can permanently bind one via a long prayer ceremony sacrificing appropriate valuables and energy.
